name: Darinor Plaza
summary: Darinor Plaza is a 153,507 square foot community center located on Connecticut's primary retail corridor in affluent Norwalk, featuring key anchors Old Navy, Kohl's, and Ulta Beauty. The center attracts over 2.3 million annual visits from one of Fairfield County's wealthiest trade areas.
demographics: Darinor Plaza serves an affluent Fairfield County market with a 5-mile trade area population of 172,905 and daytime population of 176,044. The primary customer base consists of upper-income households with an average household income of $220,635 and average home values of $944,321, representing one of the wealthiest retail markets in Connecticut. The center attracts a diverse mix of families and professionals seeking convenient shopping along the Route 1 corridor, with strong appeal to middle-to-upper income shoppers drawn to value-oriented national retailers like Old Navy, Kohl's, and Ulta.
description: Darinor Plaza is a prominent community shopping center strategically positioned on Connecticut's primary retail corridor along U.S. Route 1 in Norwalk, one of Fairfield County's most affluent markets. Spanning 153,507 square feet, this open-air center serves as a convenient shopping destination for the surrounding communities with over 2.3 million annual visits. The property is anchored by nationally recognized retailers including Old Navy, Kohl's, and Ulta Beauty, offering a compelling mix of fashion, home goods, and beauty products that cater to the area's discerning shoppers. Located at 500 Connecticut Avenue, the center benefits from its position in a trade area characterized by exceptional demographics, with average household incomes exceeding $220,000 and home values approaching $1 million within a five-mile radius. Managed by Regency Centers, a leading national shopping center developer and operator, Darinor Plaza exemplifies the company's commitment to developing thriving retail destinations that serve as integral parts of their communities.
